text: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health. 2.Aged 30 or under. 3.Possession of a high school diploma or above. 4.TOEFL 80 with no section less than 20 /IELTS 6.0 with no band less than 5.5/Duolingo English Test 115 with no subscore less than 115. 5.CSCA transcript.
